structured_output.what_is_happening: "🐻Bear" is a 37-minute-old token that launched straight into a PumpSwap pool. It never went through the pump.fun bonding curve (migrated_unix=0, created_unix is the same as pool creation). The creator supplied the liquidity, and none of it is locked or burned. The pool holds $65k of liquidity against a $52k market cap, so liquidity is larger than the market cap. Price is up about 115-139% in the first hour on $263k of volume, which is 4x turnover. At least six other tokens with the identical "🐻Bear" symbol and name were created in the prior ~75 minutes. All of them now show $0 liquidity, which fits a serial launch-and-pull farm.

narrative.description: A generic animal/'bear' meme with no website, no socials, no DexScreener profile and no description. Nothing in the packet shows an outside event or story behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: The activity looks manufactured rather than organic. In the last 30 minutes about 1,523 buys came from only ~103 unique buyers, and GMGN flags 24 bundler wallets. The 1,123 unique buyers against 114 sellers in the first hour fits bot-seeded dust buys. None of this suggests people are actually talking about the coin.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only same-name 'Bear' that currently has liquidity and volume. That makes it the latest iteration, not the canonical one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Six earlier '🐻Bear' tokens were created between about 07:00 and 07:47 UTC, all with $0 liquidity now. Two still showed h1 volume ($32k and $86k), which suggests they were pulled very recently.

authenticity.evidence: Six identical-name clones all ended at $0 liquidity within about 90 minutes. The LP is creator-supplied and 0% locked, and RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' as danger along with few LP providers. The creator's token status is 'creator_close'. There are 24 bundler wallets and very high transaction counts per unique trader. There are no socials, smart money, KOL wallets or organic links.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't confirm on-chain that the same deployer funded the clones (funded_from is null, and creator_other_tokens=0 may reflect fresh deployer wallets). The top-10 holder share outside the pool is fairly low at about 14%.

structural_risks: LP is unlocked and supplied by the creator, so it can be removed at any moment
Same-name clones rugged in sequence over the past ~90 minutes
Liquidity above market cap is a sign of an artificial pool setup
24 bundler wallets and bot-like trade counts
One wallet holds 10.55%, which may be linked to the deployer
Entry is 25 minutes after detection, into a coin already up 115-139% whose momentum is flattening (m5 -1% on GeckoTerminal)

structured_output.counterargument: Sometimes one clone in a serial series gets real organic flow and the deployer lets it run. Top-10 concentration outside the pool is only 14%, the token is not a honeypot and has no taxes, and it has 1,100+ holders. If real buyers keep arriving, a $52k coin doubling to about $105k within 6 hours is plausible.
unknowns: Whether the same deployer launched the clone tokens
Who controls the LP tokens and the 10.55% holder

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a serial LP-rug farm. Seven identical '🐻Bear' tokens appeared within about 90 minutes, and every earlier one now has zero liquidity. This one has creator-supplied, unlocked LP, bundled bot volume, and no socials. The likely outcome is that liquidity is pulled within hours, probably before a 2x from an entry that is already up more than 100%.
